I thought that Ambulance spot was extremely stupid. They took Je’Von out of the match for a majority of it, he came back, spent like 5 entire minutes setting up a ladder completely away from the center of the ring, and looked like a complete idiot climbing and reaching for the briefcase. The set up was so long and awkward. 

Je’Von falling through the ambulance itself was awesome. But pausing the entire flow of the match and having Je’Von pretend not to notice he was NOWHERE near the briefcase as he was setting up the ladder/climbing it was not worth it imo. Having Evans be in MITB just so he can do an “epic viral spot” while looking dumb in the process and get removed from the rest of the match felt like a waste of time to me. 

I saw everyone else loved it though so I’m aware it’s more of a me thing.
